name: Coffee C
read: Coffee C Mar 27 options (on MAR 27 futures 262.6, 78 days to expiry 2027-02-10): at-the-money implied vol 36.4%, -0.4 pts vs 2026-11-18. 20-day realized vol 28.2%, so options trade at a premium of 8.2 pts. 25-delta risk reversal +2.1 (calls over puts). Over the last 10 sessions (2026-11-11 to 2026-11-24) call open interest fell 41,290 and puts fell 67,889; put/call OI 1.32 → 1.14, front futures 264.65 → 262.6. Delta-weighted, option holders added about +2,215 futures-equivalent lots in the last 5 sessions (net long exposure bought through options). Front ATM vol 36.7% → 36.4%. Largest Mar 27 strikes: 300 calls (3,169 lots) and 200 puts (4,403). Biggest 5-session builds: May 27 420 calls +509; Dec 27 180 puts +500. Biggest cut: Mar 27 250 puts -955.
